data.name: Nakul
data.gender_notes: Nakul is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit nakula, 'mongoose'. Its root is Sanskrit nakula (नकुल). Nakula, one of the Pandavas in the Mahabharata. Nakul is a Sanskrit name meaning “Mongoose; (also) a Pandava's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nakul expresses “Mongoose; (also) a Pandava's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nakul total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
